'''Horizon Holding Co''' is a company name in the [[HN Group#Brand|HN Group brand library]], which includes an approved logo, roundel and app icon for it. Its role within [[HN Group]] has not yet been documented on this wiki.

Horizon Holding Co is a separate name from HN Group: its logo is not a substitute for the HN Group wordmark.

== Brand ==
[[File:horizon-holding-co-roundel.svg|thumb|The Horizon Holding Co roundel]]
Like the other Horizon companies' logos, Horizon Holding Co's logo is a thick indigo ring containing its initials, alongside the company name.
